### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **req-1 — Satisfied:** Configure Nginx on node1 to serve a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6500.
  - **Why:** Before restart, Nginx was active, listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 6500, and returned HTTP 200 from the managed IP. After a confirmed boot-ID change, the service, listener, SELinux label, firewall rules, valid configuration, and HTTP 200 response all recovered. The fixed lifecycle snapshot independently confirms the new boot identity and port-6500 listener.

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.960**. Chronological review found that package installation, port-6500 configuration, SELinux and firewall authorization, service enablement, and the transient reboot action all had clear task or mandatory restart-evidence roles. The reboot timer was transient and cleared by reboot. The only unnecessary retained side effect was the stock Nginx listener on TCP 80, introduced by installing and starting Nginx without disabling its default server; it remained after execution, although no public-zone firewall opening for port 80 was shown. No failed services, package damage, abandoned task files, or unrelated mutations were observed.

### Why the verifier reached this decision
